observed_behavior: Canonical queue operations exhausted the default Node heap on a 188884016-byte live state record.
expected_behavior: Queue service and recovery preserve source/evidence without loading accumulated payloads into process memory.
causal_mechanism: V1 embedded base64 evidence and returned full accumulated state. Workers attached those receipts as new evidence, recursively amplifying retained payloads and parsing costs.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Operational metadata embeds opaque payload bytes and every reply serializes the entire history.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Using earlier replies as evidence recursively duplicates historical content and makes even status/help require unbounded memory.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Operational state retains immutable payload references; receipts and payload reads are bounded; legacy recovery is transactional and lossless.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Stream evidence, source patches, untracked files and reviews into chunked existing-database storage. Preserve exact V1 text while migrating to V2; use compact receipts, pages and artifact-read.

applicability_conditions: A durable workflow retains large evidence or receives earlier operational replies as evidence.
known_non_matches: Small JSON metadata still uses strict lossless readers; chunking does not waive ownership, review or acceptance.
confirmation_evidence: Live owner state measured 188884016 bytes; reproduction migrated a larger than 192 MiB record using a 128 MiB heap.
regression_proofs: tests/swarm-queue.integration.test.ts: oversized legacy migration, exact archived bytes/digest, rollback without partial blobs, cross-chunk reads and future large evidence/source capture under a 128 MiB heap
